snippet.title: Konbini Cleanup - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Konbini Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 2,928 products in a messy konbini. Clean, learn abilities, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4951190/Konbini_Cleanup/
